Highlights:
# IRDM PRO SLIM SSD

### Upgrade for your console

The IRDM PRO SLIM drive is the perfect solution for computers and laptops, but especially for the latest generation PlayStation™ 5 console, which requires a smooth and stable drive that works under heavy load. The IRDM PRO SLIM drive is the ideal solution for gamers who appreciate the speed, smoothness and stability of the device and at the same time want to experience an extraordinary entertainment experience.

The ease of installation and full compatibility with PlayStation™ 5** allows you to quickly and seamlessly upgrade your PlayStation™ 5 console to enjoy up to 4 TB of additional storage space for new games and applications!

##### Key features

- Available capacities: 

 1000 GB 2000 GB 4000 GB 
- High-speed PCIe gen 4 x4 interface
- NVMe 1.4 support
- eight-channel Phison E18 controller with DRAM buffer
- 5-year TBW * limited warranty with free technical support

### High-speed interface for even better entertainment

IRDM’s latest product uses one of the most efficient interfaces currently available on the market, PCIe 4 x4, which provides extremely fast data transfer speeds.

Maximum read speeds are 7000 MB/s and write speeds of 6850 MB/s, which allow for lightning-fast booting of games, applications and the operating system itself. The IRDM PRO SLIM drive is a guarantee of smooth, trouble-free operation and entertainment.

...

### Wide range of capacities

The latest IRDM PRO SLIM drive is aimed at gamers, professionals and new technology enthusiasts. It is available in three capacity variants: 1, 2 and 4 TB. This allows you to choose the version that meets all your needs.

Whether you play a few games or like to have a whole library of different titles at hand, the IRDM PRO SLIM drive will provide you with enough space for all your games and files.

...

##### What is the IRDM PRO SLIM drive? 

The IRDM PRO SLIM is a fourth-generation SSD on an M.2 connector that, thanks to NVMe technology, has very fast read and write speeds and the right dimensions to fit the drive into PlayStation™5 * consoles, PCs and laptops.
